data.body: Gerrit CI attempt 3 reached 99% before an unrelated xdist worker crash on Ubuntu Python 3.11 while running tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted. Evidence: 11,517 passed, 66 skipped; worker gw3 was not properly terminated, coverage collapsed to 14.71% because the worker data was lost, and there was no assertion traceback. The other completed lanes were green. Classified as CI flake; no patch change. Posted the documented CI-only recheck, which started replacement run 31282060961.
